audit.corrected: phases[0-5].side -> Vel'Koz, phases[6].side -> Morgana, ratings adjusted to reflect the enemy favour early and the owner favour late, why text rewritten to match the grounded content reasoning.

audit.why: Level 6 (his channelled R out-ranging Soul Shackles) and first item (Q refract + guaranteed E knockup) power spikes are already correctly stated in content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Tectonic Disruption as matchup-defining but never gives its real cooldown, and the true-damage bypass from Organic Deconstruction (P) / Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) flagged in missingInteractions is not stated anywhere in writable fields.

edits.before: W-chip the pair — the pool taxes bot's formations politely from one.
edits.after: His Q out-ranges Bind and pokes free — you have no early trade tool.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the three-second root is the lane's longest sentence.
edits.after: Q-E zones the wave and chunks your ADC before you can close the gap.

edits.before: Full kit: the black shield pre-answers their entire support's kit.
edits.after: His passive poke stacks faster than you can punish — he stays in control.

edits.before: Bank the root and shield the engage attempts — the lane plays at your Q's pleasure.
edits.after: Ramping poke and E knock-up keep you pinned behind minions through 4-5.

edits.before: Soul Shackles online — close-range fights end in a double stun you started.
edits.after: His channelled R out-ranges Soul Shackles — he wins the level 6 ult trade.

edits.before: First item: the root converts and the shields multiply.
edits.after: Q refracts and E guarantees the knock-up — one Shield isn't enough.

edits.before: Late Morgana erases playbooks: black-shield the engage's target and root the diver who insisted.
edits.after: Flash-Bind or Zhonya's Shackles deletes him, and Shield turns off his combo.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Body-block Q with your own frame — your W does nothing to answer his poke.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Don't burn Black Shield on chip damage — bank it for the E knock-up or the R tick.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Black Shield banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Tectonic Disruption (E) is 12-10s CD by rank — dodge the knockup and the true-damage rotation stalls for that window. - Keep E Black Shield banked for the knockup or first R tick, not chip poke. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
